content: {"doneWhen":{"path":"farm.parsnips_planted_and_watered","op":"eq","value":6},"modes":[{"id":"mode","priority":10,"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push({x, y}); } } for (const t of tiles) { b.log('working tile ' + t.x + ',' + t.y); let r = await b.workTile(t.x, t.y, 0, 'ControllerX'); b.log('till: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(t.x, t.y, 2, 'ControllerA'); b.log('plant: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(t.x, t.y, 1, 'ControllerX'); b.log('water: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); } return {ok: true, detail: 'worked ' + tiles.length + ' tiles'}; }","check":"async (b) => { const items = await b.items(); const seeds = items.find(i => i.name && i.name.toLowerCase().includes('parsnip')); const left = seeds ? seeds.stack : 0; return {ok: left === 0, detail: 'parsnip seeds left: ' + left}; }"}]}
